AUTH-001.user_job: Signup, login, logout, and authenticated session — replacing default-session identity
AUTH-001.outcome: Production auth rail replacing hardcoded authenticated:true. NEW: /api/auth/signup → creates UserAggregate + password hashed via Node scrypt; /api/auth/login → validates credentials returns signed session cookie; /api/auth/logout → clears cookie. FIX: /api/session authenticated field reflects REAL session presence (not hardcoded true). FIX: proxy.ts does NOT auto-create authenticated:false flag when cookie absent, creates anonymous placeholder session instead. identity.commands.ts registerUser/authenticateUser/logoutUser added to capability-command-registry with prefix aliases identity/auth/i. Session cookie base64url includes REAL actorId/userId NOT operator.web.
acceptance: POST /api/auth/signup {email, password, displayName} → 201 {userId, actorId, actorLabel}. Duplicate email → 409 Conflict. Password min 8 chars → 422. Returns set-cookie eos-workspace-session with REAL actorId
POST /api/auth/login {email, password} → 200 {authenticated:true, actorId}. Wrong credentials → 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/auth/logout → 200 {ok:true} and clears cookie (set-cookie expired)
GET /api/session no cookie: authenticated:false, session.actorId = 'anonymous.user'. Previously authenticated:true HARDCODED → NOW CORRECTLY false
GET /api/session WITH login cookie: authenticated:true AND session.actorId matches real userId (NOT operator.web). Verified via response.headers x-eos-actor-id
proxy.ts: preserves existing cookie if present, ELSE creates anonymous session (authenticated:false downstream). No longer spoofs operator.web for everyone
identity.commands.ts {identity.registerUser, identity.authenticateUser, identity.logoutUser} registered in GLOBAL_REGISTRY with 3 aliases in CAPABILITY_PREFIX_ALIASES
Password hashing: Node crypto.scryptSync + 16-byte salt, format salt$hash stored in UserAggregate.passwordHash. PLAINTEXT NEVER stored
tests/session-api.test.ts extended with login/signup/logout flows: 6+ NEW tests all PASS, plus existing 2 tests ADAPTED/UPDATED for authenticated:false default behavior
REGRESSION FREE: LawyersHub 8/8, Services.ID 8/8, ILC 9/9 ALL PASS unchanged (25/25 preserved)
New tests: tests/auth.test.ts 8/8 PASS (signup duplicate, login wrong, logout clear, session anonymous→authenticated transition, proxy middleware anonymous context)
